faq.q: Is the instant check really free?
faq.a: Yes. The structural USCC check runs in your browser with no account and no cost.

faq.q: Do you contact the company I look up?
faq.a: Never. Every signal comes from public registration data, court records and public media.

faq.q: What does a valid code not tell me?
faq.a: A valid USCC proves the code is well-formed, not that the company is active, solvent, or who really controls it. That is what the full report is for.

faq.q: Can my AI agent call this?
faq.a: Yes — there is a remote MCP endpoint with pay-per-call access. See the MCP server page.

legalRight: Independent supplier due-diligence. Not a credit-reporting agency.
